name: setColorScheme
description: Set the profile's browser colour scheme via ThemeService::SetBrowserColorScheme (pref browser.theme.color_scheme2). Chrome's ColorChangeUpdater fires, the panel re-resolves chrome://theme/colors.css and re-posts nexus-theme, so the guest repaints without a reload. Returns {ok:true}. Takes effect immediately — no restart.

inputs.name: scheme
inputs.description: One of "system", "light", "dark". Anything else is rejected as invalid args.
